Astronomer Michelle Thaller joins the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2506. Thaller has spent years explaining space science to the public through NASA outreach and TV work. With Rogan she gets hours to do it slowly, in plain words.

The talk ranges across the cosmos she studies, from stars and black holes to the odds of life elsewhere. Rogan asks the big naive questions, and Thaller answers with both facts and wonder. The episode suits listeners who want real astronomy without a lecture hall, guided by a scientist known for making hard ideas feel close.
